Update28 June 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - Jun 28, 2026
The World Boss Cycle begins. ⚡ Tempest reworks Red Dragon, Kraken & Hanure with new interactive spawn mechanics, buffs world boss gear, upgrades Berserker & Kraken equipment, introduces Discord Rich Presence, and more.

World Boss Changes 1: Tempest

Boss Spawn Changes

  • The following bosses' spawn method has been changed: Red Dragon, Kraken, Hanure the Berserker
  • Each boss will now have an "egg" (or a gong for Berserker) responsible for managing their spawn timers
  • The egg works as follow:
    • Growth phase: 56 hours (160 hours for berserker)
      • The egg is visible and shows its timer to the Active phase
    • Active phase: 1 hour
      • The egg can be touched by any player to spawn the boss.
    • Cooldown phase: 2 hours
      • The egg goes invisible while the fight occurs
      • After cooldown, the boss enters growth again

Boss Equipment Updates

  • World Boss Shields have had bonus +Physical Defense green text added to them to bring them in line with shields of similar grades.
    • Bleak Arcadian Sea Guardian, Berserker's Plate, Stalwart Berserker's Plate and Berserk Red Dragon Fireguard will see these changes
  • Berserker Equipment Improvements
    • All Berserker Equipment have had their iLvls buffed to match Ayanad equipment (iLvl 62)
    • Berserker Equipment can now be crafted to a T2 Version using a single Berserker's Horn to increase the effects of their active buffs
      • T2 Nodachi - Buff Duration increased to 12s
      • T2 Bow - Buff Duration Increased to 12s
      • T2 Shield - Recieved Damage Decrease Effect increased to 12%
      • T2 Club - Healing Coeffcient of its active increased by 20%
    • All Berserker Regrade Rates have been changed to Match Other Boss Gear Now
  • Kraken Equipment Changes
    • All T2 Kraken Equipment (Bleak Versions) have had their iLvls buffed to Match Ayanad Equipment (iLvl 62)
    • The Potency of Kraken Inc Sacs has increased, now making T2 Kraken Crafts only requiring 1 Ink Sac to Upgrade
  • Conflict for the Red Dragon's Domain escalates
    • The Dragon has hardened it's scales while airborne, becoming immune to regular player attacks
    • Red Dragon Harpoons have been enhanced, now dealing double their regular damage
    • Red Dragon Devastor has been added to the Crafting Bench in Karkasse
      • This is an Iron Clad retrofitted to shoot massive ballistae specifically meant to pierce the Dragon's toughened scales while in the air for considerable damage
  • The Priestesses' of Nui have fled the Red Dragon's Keep and Iona, in fear for their well being and have congregated to a new safer distance away from the keep.
      • The West, East and Pirate respawns for RD have been adjusted away from the Red Dragon's keep
  • Thunderwing Titan now drops 1x [Thunderwing Titan Feather]
    • This item will be used in crafting improved Thunderwing Titan weapons in the near future
  • Additional changes planned for post 1.3.6

Features

  • ArcheAge Classic now supports Discord Rich Presence
    • Displays player name, guild, gearscore while logged in with activity turned on for discord
    • In the future, we will be integrating referral links and more fun statuses into Discord.
  • Megaphones (Global Chat) have been added to the game, and will be available in a coming marketplace update.
    • These are a consumable that allows you to send global, language-proficiency-ignoring messages across the entire server with a 45 second cooldown.
    • As with all public chat channels, Megaphones are subject to the same chat rules as usual. Please keep it clean enough that you still fall within our rules.
    • Review the rules here that would apply to public channels here: https://discord.com/channels/1095780016945631325/1095787858482180347

Bug Fixes

  • "Trion" is no longer blocked by the chat filter when sent in chat.

Addon API

  • UnitInfo restrictions on non-friendly targets have been reduced, now letting the following fields through:
    • "name", "type", "faction", "expeditionName", "level", "isAggressive", "isPlayerChar", "title", "social",
  • Please request further needs that have been disabled in https://discord.com/channels/1095780016945631325/1269479333802807421

Important Errata

Patch notes previously showed 80 hours between bosses. This has been lowered to 56 hours so that players can enjoy more bosses per week. - Aguru

📜 Patch Notes - Jun 29, 2026

  • The Megaphone Chat has been standardized to other chats
    • Color & Enable settings added per-tab
    • Fixed some issues with block list & double-messages
  • Growth Timers on Boss Eggs for Red Dragon and Kraken have been adjusted
    • Original: 80 hours >> New: 53 hour (previously lowered to 56 which didn't account for active&cooldown phases)
  • A new setting has been added in Misc. Settings: "Enable Discord Rich Presence"
    • Enabled by default, you can disable it to prevent our system from picking up and displaying your game activity on Discord
    • A client restart may be required for Discord to stop persisting the last picked up state
  • Kraken T2 Crafts material display adjusted to its actual value of 1 Ink sack
